intraday_rationale: EURUSD is currently in a steady upward drift with open positions already active, but lacks a clean, high-volume breakout or pullback to structural support necessary for an asymmetric 1:3 RR intraday execution. Pausing new entries until a clearer liquidity sweep occurs.
learning_applied: Reflecting on past XAUUSD SL failure where tight volatility trapped the entry, capital is preserved by avoiding chasing extended moves without a confirmed structural pullback.
